description: The run decision record. Every model here is passed explicitly on every call (claude --model, codex -m) — account and CLI defaults are never reachable. Change a decision here, in the studio's settings panel (which writes this file), or per-session via env (CLAUDE_MODEL / CODEX_MODEL / CODEX_EFFORT / ROUND_CAP).

maker.why: Claude Code alias, stable across CLI versions; drafts and fixes are research+writing work where Sonnet's speed/cost fits a live demo. Decided 2026-07-12.

reviewer.why: Revisited deliberately 2026-07-19, as the previous pin's note required. Two conditions changed: codex-cli is now 0.144.1 (was 0.137.0), so this line is reachable; and codex demoted gpt-5.4 to hidden in its own catalog, so the old pin was no longer selectable in Settings. Verified by live fire 2026-07-19: answered the review schema, normalized to a real REVISE with 3 findings, and classified a proposed-threshold ledger entry as policy with cited reasoning (18.2k in / 654 out, 32s at low effort). Effort stays low to keep demo rounds fast — the low-vs-high difference is shown as its own comparison rather than assumed.
